data.heading: Programs & Training Zones
data.subheading: Whether you are starting out or getting back in shape, there is a lane for you on our floor.

services.name: Strength & Free Weights
services.description: Barbells, plates, benches and racks with room to train properly — no queuing for equipment, even at peak hours.

services.name: Personal Training
services.description: One-on-one coaching with a program built around your body, your schedule and your goals — reviewed every month.

services.name: Boxing & Conditioning
services.description: Heavy bags, pads and footwork drills that build engine and confidence — gloves provided for your first sessions.

services.name: Kettlebells & Functional Zone
services.description: Kettlebells, medicine balls and open floor space for circuits, mobility work and athletic conditioning.

services.name: Small-Group Training
services.description: Capped groups of six so the coach still sees every rep — the smart middle ground between a class and personal training.

services.name: Open Gym Floor Access
services.description: Walk in, pay at the desk and use the full floor — machines, weights, boxing corner and changing rooms. No registration needed.

data.heading: What Our Members Say
data.subheading: Real people who train here every week — students, professionals and morning regulars.

testimonials.name: Brian K.
testimonials.text: The trainers actually watch your form. I walked in barely benching the bar — six months later I have a real program and the strength to match.

testimonials.name: Sharon A.
testimonials.text: The monthly rate is honest for students and it opens early before lectures. The boxing corner on Fridays is my favourite part of the week.

testimonials.name: Peter S.
testimonials.text: Clean equipment, good music, no pressure to sign anything. I have kept my 6 AM routine for a year now — this place made it stick.
